content: आतुर {%a.%} [ईषदर्थे आ, अत्-उरच्] .²1 Hurt, injured. .²2 Suffering from, influenced or affected by, tormented, afflicted; रावणावरजा तत्र राघवं मदनातुरा <ls>R. 12. 32</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 25</ls>; so काम˚, भय˚, व्याधि˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Sick (in body or mind), disabled, diseased; आकाशेशास्तु विज्ञेया बालवृद्धकृशातुराः <ls>Ms. 4. 184</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">6. 77</ls>. .²4 Eager, over-anxious; <ls>M. 2</ls>. .²5 Weak, feeble, incapable of doing anything. .{@-रः@} .²1 A patient, one suffering from a disease <ls>V. 3</ls>; आतुराणां चिकित्सकाः <ls>Pt. 1. 155</ls>. .²2 Illness, disease; आतुरे व्यसने प्राप्ते <ls>Pt. 5. 41</ls>.
